notes: This minor release adds six direct generation jobs: bifrost.java.lombok, bifrost.rust.getset, bifrost.scala.case-class, bifrost.python-process-inputs, bifrost.node-runtime-values-javascript and bifrost.node-runtime-values-typescript. They carry only rules or runtime values, which the Bifrost 0.14.0 producer of packs 0.8.0 could not measure. Their authored models move to the version-independent schema-8 compatibility shape; shard payloads, identities, provenance, licenses and completeness are unchanged. With them the native bundle contains every pack that Bifrost's legacy embedded registry provides, so offline installs and BIFROST_OPEN_PACKS_DISABLE users can take all 46 built-in packs from this release. The generator moves from a Bifrost 0.14.0 source build to the released, checksum-pinned bifrost-semantic-pack 0.15.0 binary from the v0.15.0 release of public commit fc4a2da2b78c938e811c496b3c21e5b02f415048 (executable SHA-256 d6c19acdcbf37d495e4c0b3f7490746e6235da3522aba5deba4c78f904312031); it is not built from source. The bundle uses release index schema 4, and generated productions use semantic-model schema 19, or 21 for bifrost.external.java, instead of 17. This tightens what a consumer must read: an engine that reads only index schema 3 skips this release, so use Bifrost 0.15.0 or later. All other jobs and recipes are unchanged from 0.8.0. Rules 0.8.0 keeps its exact dependency on packs 0.8.0, so normal acquisition through the rules stream selects this release only after a later rules release moves that dependency. Generation, integrity, compatibility and per-run completeness remain separate from behavior qualification.
